column1: # Round 1: isolate the bottleneck. Is it message passing, or the TM head on this target?
# Round 2: centre-node message fill is 96-98% (98 senders x 6 in-edges x 2 bits into 256 bits):
# an overloaded Bloom filter. Aim for ~50% at the centre at the same 4.42M params: depth 2 (one
# hop over +-1/+-2 = the flat oracle's receptive field) frees the budget for msg-size 512,
# 1 bit per sender, empty [MASK] code so centre clauses stop broadcasting.
# Round 3: R2b (depth 2, msg 512, 1 bit/sender, +-1/2, normal MASK) reached 0.281 acc@10 at 2M = 91% of the
# flat oracle; empty MASK kills senders (context clauses lose positive literals). Now: longer context
# (+-4 edges; 2 hops at matched params), larger messages at matched params, s, and a +-8 flat oracle.
# Round 4 (sender autopsy): a context clause whose deeper message layers block everywhere counts as
# not fired, and Type I "forget" then erodes ALL its layers including layer 0 -> it loses its
# positive literals -> it can no longer send -> fill drops -> more clauses block (cascade). Message
# automata start 1 state below include, so ~100 near-always-true message bits lock in at once.
# Residual init (@ri=K): message-layer automata start K states below include (pass-through), so a
# clause starts as its layer-0 part and adds message literals only after ~K net reinforcements.
# Autopsy: a literal-budget explanation was tested and REFUTED (--max-inc 4096 still empties layer 0).
# Measured cause: ~72% of a clause's Type I events arrive while its final conjunction is false
# everywhere ("forget", applied to ALL layers at 1/s). Per layer-0 token literal (true ~50%):
# +0.07*(0.5-0.5/s) [Type I fired] +0.07*0.5 [Type II] -0.34/s [forget] = ~-0.005 at s=5: zero drift,
# no restoring force; depth 3's transient tips it to empty and senders die. s=3/5/10 -> layer-0
# literals 1.0/1.4/3.3 and acc@10 0.278/0.281/0.285, as predicted. Fix: per-layer s (layer 0 high).
# Round 6: Byte Latent Transformer front end, Tsetlin-native (blt.py): byte + hash n-gram (3..8,
# RollPolyHash) fixed +-1 embeddings, entropy patching (count-based char LM, global threshold,
# ~4.5 bytes/patch), patch code = sign(sum) of its byte vectors (majority-bundle pooling). Same
# validation windows as all runs above. Linear readout of +-2 patches: 0.298 acc@10 vs 0.301 random codes.
